obligations.note: The diff removes `self._audit(actor, "amend_memo", f"payment:{payment_id}")` from `LedgerService.amend_memo` in service.py and replaces it with an application log line. Amending a payment memo changes stored state, so it no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target and time. The sample-coverage control test passing does not cure this.
The new `_log.info("payment memo updated", payment_id=payment_id)` call site logs only the internal payment id, which is not NPI. No other log call sites change.
Ticket CHG-26751 is a standard ticket approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-21, before review. Its component payments.service covers the only touched file, service.py.
sofia.santos@fernbrook.example gave a code_review approval. She holds change_approver for payments and is a different person from the author, Linh Nguyen.
The approval names the head commit 934a0c64, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims success on the head commit from executor ci-runner-07. The JUnit report it references, however, records hostname dev-laptop-7.local, a personal machine. That provenance mismatch means I cannot confirm the suite ran in CI on the final commit.
The only touched component, payments.service, is not marked security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests, ci/) are changed.
The change is not an emergency and the ticket type is standard, so no post-implementation review is due.
The change relies on no exception. The register has no exception for AUD-1 on payments.service, so nothing excuses the AUD-1 deviation.
No ledger entry covers service.py. The covered code (payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and the mortgage files) is unchanged, so no evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1559 replaces the audit event in `amend_memo` with an application log line. The PR describes this as a telemetry streamline, but it actually removes audit coverage of a state-changing operation, which violates AUD-1. In addition, the CI JUnit report was produced on a personal workstation rather than the named CI executor, so testing evidence on the final commit is unverified. The ticket and code-review approval are otherwise in order. The change is rejected because AUD-1 is refuted.
